notes: This branch includes the four earlier enhancements plus the new five-part work, with a release gate in front of their business imports.
The previous cloud ImportError was reproduced with a stale core.llm module; the exact cause on the cloud instance was not confirmed.
Research archives are explicit portable backups, not account-based automatic persistence. Original uploaded files are included only when selected and are preserved as-is.
No Streamlit service was changed during this work.
